description: Source code for the Job Card doctype in ERPNext manufacturing module, defining the JobCard class with methods for validation, scheduling, and updating manufacturing work orders, as well as utility functions for creating related documents and handling time logs.

classes.name: OverlapError
classes.description: Custom validation error for overlapping time logs.

classes.name: OperationMismatchError
classes.description: Custom validation error for operation mismatch.

classes.name: OperationSequenceError
classes.description: Custom validation error for operation sequence issues.

classes.name: JobCardCancelError
classes.description: Custom validation error for job card cancellation issues.

classes.name: JobCard
classes.description: Main class representing a manufacturing job card with methods for validation, scheduling, updating work orders, and managing time logs.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Loads additional data such as excess transfer setting and work order status when the document is loaded.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks before saving or submitting the job card.

methods.name: set_sub_operations
methods.description: Sets sub-operations related to the main operation.

methods.name: validate_time_logs
methods.description: Validates time logs for overlaps and calculates total time and completed quantities.

methods.name: get_overlap_for
methods.description: Checks for overlapping time logs for the same workstation or employee.

methods.name: schedule_time_logs
methods.description: Schedules time logs considering workstation availability.

methods.name: validate_overlap_for_workstation
methods.description: Adjusts start time if overlapping with existing logs.

methods.name: check_workstation_time
methods.description: Validates and adjusts planned times based on workstation working hours and holidays.

methods.name: add_time_log
methods.description: Adds a new time log entry, handling start and complete times.

methods.name: add_start_time_log
methods.description: Appends a start time log.

methods.name: set_employees
methods.description: Assigns employees to the job card.

methods.name: reset_timer_value
methods.description: Resets timing-related attributes.

methods.name: update_sub_operation_status
methods.description: Updates the status of sub-operations based on time logs.

methods.name: update_time_logs
methods.description: Updates the time logs with new planned start and end times.

methods.name: get_required_items
methods.description: Fetches required raw materials based on the work order.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Validates and updates work order data upon submission.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Updates work order data upon cancellation.

methods.name: validate_transfer_qty
methods.description: Ensures transfer quantities are sufficient.

methods.name: validate_job_card
methods.description: Checks for work order status, time logs, and quantity correctness.

methods.name: update_work_order
methods.description: Updates related work order with production data.

methods.name: update_corrective_in_work_order
methods.description: Calculates corrective operation costs for the work order.

methods.name: validate_produced_quantity
methods.description: Ensures produced quantity does not exceed planned quantity.

methods.name: update_work_order_data
methods.description: Updates work order operation data with actuals.

methods.name: get_current_operation_data
methods.description: Retrieves current operation progress data.

methods.name: set_transferred_qty_in_job_card
methods.description: Sets transferred quantity for job card items based on stock entries.

methods.name: set_transferred_qty
methods.description: Calculates total transferred quantity for the job card.

methods.name: set_status
methods.description: Sets the status of the job card based on progress.

methods.name: validate_operation_id
methods.description: Validates that the operation belongs to the work order.

methods.name: validate_sequence_id
methods.description: Ensures operations follow the correct sequence.

methods.name: validate_work_order
methods.description: Checks if the work order is closed.

methods.name: is_work_order_closed
methods.description: Returns True if the work order is closed.
